late_convergent_deltas.gap: Current checkpoint logic can hash live UnifiedDB before inserting the receipt that records that hash, and can capture graph epoch before a later graph-file hash. The receipt may therefore refer to mutually different logical instants and its own insert can invalidate the recorded UnifiedDB file hash.
architecture_delta: materialize immutable consistent backup artifact first
hash immutable artifact rather than live mutable DB
persist receipt outside the artifact or define an explicit canonical exclusion scheme
do not claim UnifiedDB+ClayGraph pair snapshot without an atomic barrier/validated snapshot protocol
authoritative recovery may omit ClayGraph artifact and rebuild derived Graph from admitted UnifiedDB
late_convergent_deltas.falsifier: inject valid Graph advancement between serial capture steps; snapshot receipt must either serialize/barrier the state or explicitly classify Graph as independently rebuildable

late_convergent_deltas.gap: Exact Git HEAD equality is broader than the semantic/runtime dependency set. An unrelated/evidence-only commit can change HEAD and invalidate otherwise identical UnifiedDB/ClayGraph verification.

architecture_delta.authority_identity: bind boot/materialization validity to a content-addressed semantic dependency manifest of relevant migration/runtime/materializer blobs + canonical semantic root/contract
architecture_delta.graph_identity: bind Graph to canonical UnifiedDB materialization/root plus its own relevant materializer dependencies
architecture_delta.non_dependency_repo_changes: do not invalidate canonical DB authority

late_convergent_deltas.falsifier: change only observed repo HEAD while DB bytes, schema, semantic root and dependency-manifest digests remain unchanged; authoritative open must remain valid while provenance records the newer unrelated HEAD

derived_law: provenance may record a superset of context, but authority validity must depend only on the minimal content-addressed semantic dependency set plus dynamic canonical state identity
